record.evidence_quote: The ionic conductivity of Li1/3 Pb1/3 Bi1/3 Te at T = 1.0 (295 K) was calculated to be 6.8 × 10−3 S/cm since unit
record.notes: Molecular dynamics simulation under an applied electric field, not an experimental measurement. Temperature is given in reduced units T = 1.0 corresponding to 295 K (T0 = 295 K). Composition is a random substitutional model; Pb and Bi are structural cations, not dopants. The same value is repeated in the Summary as 6.8 × 10−3 S/cm at 295K. No activation energy is reported.
